summary: ChatGPT still cites paid-MCP and agent-payment source hosts that do not mention Synapse. This audit separates source hosts with a realistic contact/submission path from source hosts that need manual partner or GitHub outreach, and records the TensorFeed wantlist signal that was submitted after the initial audit.

hosts.title: agent402.dev | MCP Gateway Documentation

ai_crawler_surface.robots_summary: User-agent: * allows / and advertises sitemap.xml plus MCP endpoints.

hosts.recommended_action: Do not attempt automated submission. Use this as a comparison/adjacent source host: publish or pitch a truthful Synapse vs agent402/x402 MCP payments comparison and look for a GitHub/X/manual partner contact path before claiming third-party evidence.
hosts.next_validation: Only mark agent402 source-host progress after a public third-party page, issue, PR, or partner mention URL includes Synapse Network plus the Remote MCP endpoint or GitHub repository.

hosts.title: TensorFeed: Real-time AI news, model tracking, and ecosystem data

ai_crawler_surface.robots_summary: Allows GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, and other AI crawlers.

hosts.recommended_action: Keep the short, factual news/ecosystem submission email and X DM/reply draft ready for operator-approved outreach. The public wantlist signal is live, but it is not a TensorFeed article, dataset entry, or citation yet.
hosts.next_validation: Record the sent email/thread URL only after operator approval. Success requires a public TensorFeed article/listing/source-host page, not merely a wantlist signal or email draft.

do_not_count_as_success: A draft email that has not been sent.
A competitor-owned page that does not mention Synapse.
A probe failure caused by provider quota or credit limits.
